subject.title: [codex] fix launchd restart when gateway port is busy

question: Should this PR land as the scoped fix that lets launchd replace a busy managed gateway listener on restart, or should it preserve a pre-kickstart foreign-listener or health gate before merge?
rationale: The code change is small and well-proven, but it changes the availability semantics of a managed macOS gateway restart; automation cannot safely decide whether launchctl success alone is the right boundary for all callers.

options.title: Land the scoped launchd fix
options.body: Accept launchd-owned replacement for the expected managed listener and keep broader restart, update, and session recovery work tracked separately.

options.title: Require a stricter gate
options.body: Ask for a revision that distinguishes expected managed listeners from foreign port owners or adds post-kickstart health proof before reporting completion.

options.title: Pause for unified restart semantics
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want busy-port handling, SIGTERM intent ordering, and update handoff success criteria solved together.

recommendation.title: Land the scoped launchd fix
recommendation.body: Accept launchd-owned replacement for the expected managed listener and keep broader restart, update, and session recovery work tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed adjacent launchd port-release behavior in PR 95886 and explicitly separated this restart-before-kickstart decision from that fix.
